pain_points: A dead battery turns a normal morning into a missed shift.
Jump-starting from another car means waiting for a stranger to show up.
Cables can spark if they are connected in the wrong order.
A phone near zero battery leaves you without a map or a roadside contact.
Parking far from a garage makes a weak battery feel riskier.
Cold mornings expose an aging battery at the worst possible moment.
Road trips magnify small preparation gaps.
A compact trunk leaves little room for bulky emergency gear.
Diesel and larger engines make drivers worry about compatibility.
Dark roadside checks are hard without a dedicated light source.
hooks: Your morning starts with a click, not an engine.
A dead battery does not check your calendar.
Stop waiting for another car to show up.
The wrong cable connection can spark.
One compact unit covers a dead battery and a low phone.
Look under the hood with light, not a phone screen.
Six liters of gas, three of diesel, one small box.
The trunk stays usable when the backup lives in it.
Roadside confidence starts before you leave the driveway.
A cold morning is the wrong time to test an old battery.

winning_combo.justification: The hook names the exact sound of a failed start and the pain maps it to a lost morning; both are filmable with the compact unit in a trunk.

script_30s.voiceover: It starts with a click instead of an engine.

script_30s.voiceover: You do not need to wait for another driver.

script_30s.voiceover: The same unit can charge a phone and light the work area.

script_30s.voiceover: Check the latest price on Amazon and keep one within reach.
